# nimbiCMS — Machine-Readable Project Summary

## Identity

- **name**: nimbi-cms
- **version**: 1.1.0
- **description**: Lightweight, client-side CMS for static sites. No database, no build step, no backend — just Markdown files and a browser.
- **author**: Abel Vázquez Montoro
- **license**: MIT
- **repo**: https://github.com/AbelVM/nimbiCMS
- **homepage**: https://abelvm.github.io/nimbiCMS/
- **type**: ESM
- **source**: plain JavaScript (no TS in src/)
- **types**: generated `src/index.d.ts` from JSDoc via `scripts/gen-dts.js`

## What it does

nimbiCMS turns a folder of Markdown or HTML files into a fully functional website. It runs entirely in the browser:

- Renders GitHub-flavored Markdown to HTML on the fly
- Builds navigation, search, and table of contents automatically
- Manages URLs, slugs, and SEO meta tags (Open Graph, Twitter Cards)
- Generates runtime sitemap, RSS 2.0, and Atom 1.0 feeds
- Keeps the site fast with web workers and smart caching

Target audience: writers, editors, developers, and teams who want to publish content without managing a CMS backend. Not intended for multi-user editorial workflows.

## Runtime requirements

- **Node**: 22+ (cssnano 9 / postcss 9 require Node 22)
- **engines.node**: ">=16" (stale; intentionally untouched for semver safety)
- **Browser**: modern browsers with ES module support (for ESM build)

## Key scripts

| script | command | purpose |
|--------|---------|---------|
| test | `npx vitest run` | 799 tests, jsdom 30 |
| test:coverage | `npx vitest run --coverage` | V8 coverage |
| lint | `eslint src` | 0 errors target |
| lint:fix | `eslint src --fix` | Auto-fix lint issues |
| format | `prettier --write "src/**/*.js"` | Format source files |
| build | `npm run build:lib && npm run build:umd` | ESM + CJS + UMD |
| build:lib | `vite build --config vite.config.js` | ESM/CJS bundles |
| build:umd | `BUILD_TARGET=umd vite build --config vite.config.js` | UMD bundle |
| gen-dts | `node scripts/gen-dts.js` | generate types from JSDoc |
| check-dts | `node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc --noEmit src/index.d.ts --lib es2015,dom --skipLibCheck --ignoreConfig` | TS 7 type check |
| docs | `typedoc --options typedoc.json` | TypeDoc (TS 6 API) |
| prepare | `npm run build && npm run gen-dts && npm run docs` | CI entry point |
| benchmark:lighthouse | `node benchmarks/benchmark-lighthouse.js` | Lighthouse benchmarks |
| dev | `vite` | Dev server |

## Dependency state (2026-10-05)

- **Vitest**: 5.0.3
- **@vitest/coverage-v8**: 5.0.3
- **TypeScript**: 6.0.3 (side-by-side with 7.0.2 via `typescript7` alias)
- **jsdom**: 30
- **cssnano**: 9
- **postcss-discard-duplicates**: 9
- **postcss-merge-rules**: 9
- **puppeteer**: 25
- **marked**: 18.1.0
- **typedoc**: 0.28.20 (crashes under TS 7; requires TS 6 API)
- **tsd**: 0.33.0 (bundles its own TS 5.9.2)
- **vulnerabilities**: 11 (down from 48)

## Critical patterns

- **TS 7 aliasing**: `"typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2"` + `"typescript7": "npm:typescript@^7.0.2"` in package.json
- **Vitest 5 mocking**: `vi.mock`/`vi.doMock` must be top-level; `clearMocks: false` in vitest.config.js
- **jsdom 30 navigator**: use `Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'navigator', { value, configurable: true, writable: true, enumerable: true })`
- **puppeteer 25**: `executablePath()` returns Promise; must `await`
- **src/index.d.ts**: generated; never edit by hand

## Source layout

```
src/
├── nimbi-cms.js          # Public entrypoint
├── init.js               # initCMS() and option parsing
├── htmlBuilder.js        # Article rendering, TOC, anchors
├── nav.js                # Navigation tree building
├── slugManager.js        # Slug resolution, crawling, search index
├── markdown.js           # Markdown parsing pipeline
├── codeblocksManager.js  # Code highlighting (highlight.js)
├── hookManager.js        # Hook system
├── seoManager.js         # SEO meta tags
├── runtimeSitemap.js     # RSS/Atom/Sitemap generation
├── l10nManager.js        # Localization
├── bulmaManager.js       # Bulma theming
├── ui.js                 # UI helpers
├── imagePreview.js       # Image preview
├── indexManager.js       # Index cache management
├── router.js             # Routing logic
├── worker-manager.js     # Worker pool management
├── utils/                # Shared utilities
└── worker/               # Web Worker code
```

## Public API (high level)

- `initCMS(options)` — mount the CMS into a page
- `getVersion()` — returns package version as `Promise<string>`
- `setDebugLevel(level)` — adjust logging verbosity (0–3)
- `addHook(name, fn)` — register hook callbacks
- `onPageLoad(fn)` — hook after page render
- `onNavBuild(fn)` — hook after nav construction
- `transformHtml(fn)` — hook before article append
- `ensureBulma(bulmaCustomize?, pageDir?)` — ensure Bulma is loaded
- `setStyle(style)` — switch light/dark/system theme
- `setThemeVars(vars)` — apply CSS custom properties
- `t(key, ...args)` — translate UI string
- `loadL10nFile(url)` — fetch and merge localization file
- `setLang(code)` — switch UI language at runtime
- `registerLanguage(name, modulePath)` — register highlight.js language
- `observeCodeBlocks(root)` — apply syntax highlighting to DOM subtree
- `setHighlightTheme(name, { useCdn })` — switch highlight.js theme

For full types and JSDoc, see `docs/` or `src/index.d.ts`.

## Configuration (essential options)

```js
initCMS({
  el: '#app',              // required: mount target
  contentPath: '/content', // URL path to content folder
  homePage: 'home.md',     // home page path
  notFoundPage: '_404.md', // optional 404 page
  defaultStyle: 'light',   // 'light' | 'dark' | 'system'
  bulmaCustomize: 'none',  // 'none' | 'local' | Bulmaswatch theme name
  searchIndex: true,       // enable search box
  exposeSitemap: true      // enable runtime sitemap
})
```

All options can be overridden via URL params when `allowUrlPathOverrides: true` is set (off by default for security).

## Known issues

- `npm run type-test` fails: `src/index.test-d.ts` does not exist (pre-existing)
- `tests/nav/buildNav.more-branches.test.js` timing-flaky under parallel load
- `engines.node: ">=16"` stale (real minimum Node 22+)
- `benchmark` script points to deleted `scripts/benchmark-cdp.js`

## Verification

```bash
npm ci && npm run build && npm run gen-dts && npm run check-dts && npm test && npm run lint && npm run docs && npm run prepare
```

Expected: 0 errors, 799 passed / 0 failed.
